ios.desc:
Fluency is hard. Being understood is easier.

You don't need perfect grammar or a perfect accent to be understood. You need practice speaking out loud, without nerves or judgment. Five minutes a day with Kippy is enough to start.

Kippy is your AI speaking partner for real conversations in 10 languages (English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazilian and Portugal), Italian, German and Russian). 

MEET KIPPY, TIPPY AND YAPPY
Three conversation partners with very different personalities. Together, they help you speak the way people actually talk.

▷ Kippy is your friendly guide. He asks about your day, helps when you get stuck, and can explain things in your own language until you're ready.

▷ Tippy is sweet, playful, and always in your corner. She makes speaking practice feel a little less scary.

▷ Yappy is not here to please you. He has opinions and will challenge you, so your practice feels more like a real conversation.


THE ALL-NEW KIPPY
• Bilingual conversations: Explanations in your own language, or speak the learning when you're ready - great for beginners to start speaking a new language right away
• Hands-free voice calls
• State of the art AI models and voices

WHO KIPPY IS FOR
• You freeze when it's time to speak
• You studied a language for years but never got to use it
• You used to speak a language and want it back
• You're just starting and want to speak from day one
• You're getting ready for a trip, an interview or a move abroad

TALK ABOUT ANYTHING
• Talk to the characters like a friend about the things you care about
• 30+ real-life scenarios: ordering food, checking into a hotel, making friends, job interviews
• New conversation topics every day
• Natural, human-like voices

GET HELP WHEN YOU FREEZE UP
• Suggested replies when you're lost for words
• Instant translations
• Pronunciation check on every word
• Grammar check as you speak
• 1000s of set phrases organised into practical phrasebooks
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• A Speech Report after every conversation, with what to practice next
• Track your vocabulary and your streak
• Save your favorite phrases and practice them anytime

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

If you ever learned a foreign language, it's likely mostly forgotten unless you practice it regularly. Thousands of people are looking for speaking partners every day online.

So... I'm working on a language tutor (https://www.kippy.ai) you can speak with like a live human tutor. It will correct your grammar and pronunciation as you speak.

I've posted a video preview of the latest on my LinkedIn (feel free to connect).

The first iteration of Kippy is available in the App Store <https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6456224061?pt=642210&ct=HNYC&mt=8>

I've run a trial in Japan and South Korea for some time with good initial traction and now growing it worldwide. Any feedback, advice or intros (investors, learners groups, growth hackers) would be much appreciated.

If you (or someone you know) are learning a language, message me for a promo code.

Cheers!
Steve
